{{Quote|My family could be in that camp, I'm going in!''"<br />"''Hollis! Stay in formation.|Lieutenant Gavyn Sykes and Lutin Hollis, at the start of the battle|<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]] was '''liberated''' during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The Federation had [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] most of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|inhabitants]] and put them into camps such as Camp Four, so [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] wanted to liberate the camp to add to the [[Naboo Resistance]] as they prepared to retake their planet from the invaders. The Bravo Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] infiltrated the camp, fighting through [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] to reach it. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] stole a Federation [[STAP-2|speeder]] to sneak into the camp, and the other pilots provided cover while he freed the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]].

==Prelude==
{{Dialogue|Vedd Deviss|Now what, Lieutenant?|Gavyn Sykes|We get back to the Trade Federation, but I don't know how or where yet. And we're still short of pilots.|Kol Kotha|A few days ago the Hutt had me scout out a couple of prison camps near here. Start by liberating those and you'll get all the pilots you'll need.|Gavyn Sykes|Good idea, Kol. You're welcome to stick around. Let's move.|attr=Lieutenant Sykes and his wingmen, after the attack on Porso Hill|audio=|url=|src=<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
The [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] and occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] much of the planet. Many of the planet's leaders were put into the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Camp Four/Legends|Camp Four]],<ref name="SVC 62">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]]</ref> while Naboo's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], was forced to escape to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace novelization" /> As the battle for control of Naboo wore on, the fight became increasingly desperate.<ref name="SVC 62" /> Members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], having [[Attack on Porso Hill|dealt]] with a traitorous [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], needed to get back on the offensive, and to do so, the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] set out to liberate prison camps and gain new recruits. [[Kol Kotha]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|employee]] of Borvo, had previously [[Scout/Legends|scouted]] the camps, and he suggested they head to Camp Four.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

==The liberation==
===The valley===
{{Quote|Look at the size of that camp!|Lieutenant Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
The squadron first had to locate the camp. Under cover of darkness, Bravo Squadron infiltrated a valley, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]], the [[Flight leader/Legends|flight lead]], ordered the [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to listen to Kotha's recon report. Kotha said they had information that Camp Four was located in an area north of the valley. The Trade Federation had completely stripped the area for its own purposes. One of the pilots, [[Lutin Hollis/Legends|Lutin Hollis]], broke formation to look for the camp, because he suspected his family was in there. He gave away the squadron's position when he flew into an area occupied by an installation that was part of Camp Four, and the base responded by launching many [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]], as well as a [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|landing craft]]. Sykes ordered the flight to break and attack, and the squadron had to escape under heavy fire from the base and from a [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile turret]]. The landing craft continued its voyage through the valley to drop off [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] at processing centers.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Skyes followed and shot down the landing craft,<ref name="100%" /> which tried to fight back by launching [[airborne mine]]s from a rearward launcher. Sykes dedicated its destruction to the planet of Naboo.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

Meanwhile, more [[Droid starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and [[Trade Federation droid bomber|bombers]] attacked local [[Farm/Legends|farmhouses]]. Kotha said they did not have [[Time/Legends|time]] to help, but the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] pilots shot down the attackers anyway. With that threat eliminated, they continued the search for the camp, flying over three [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboats]] patrolling the nearby [[Water/Legends|waters]]. The [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] on Sykes' [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]] located Camp Four in the valley below them, and he reported it to the squadron and warned them to watch for anti-air [[Artillery/Legends|emplacements]]. Flying through a canyon, the squadron found a Trade Federation [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] that was releasing [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|troop carriers]]. Kotha proposed that they find a way to get in from the ground. Kotha also proposed that the Federation was using the speeders to transport prisoners from across the planet, and Sykes realized the speeders were heading straight into the camp. After shooting down the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] defenders, Sykes landed in the hangar and took a [[STAP-2|Heavy STAP]]. He [[Programmer/Legends|programmed]] several unoccupied [[Troop carrier/Legends|troop carriers]] to enter the base and followed them in.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

===The Camp===
[[File:BFN_camp_4_2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Sykes near the first cell block]]
{{Quote|Halt! Where are your prisoners?&hellip;Enemy in the compound!|A battle droid challenges Sykes at the front gate|<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
Once inside the gates, however, the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] scanned the [[Carrier/Legends|carriers]] and noticed they were unoccupied. They ordered Sykes to stop, but when he continued to head into the camp, the base went into high alert. [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Tanks]] and Heavy STAPS poured out of their hangars, but Sykes managed to destroy them. He traveled up the nearby cliff and found the first cell blocks. Kotha tried to strafe the camp's [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]] in his [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|starfighter]] but missed, and subsequent fire from [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]] drove him off, forcing Sykes to destroy it himself before moving to the next cell block.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

Once inside, the prisoners called to him. Sykes told them to stand back so he could blow the door. When they were free, the prisoners ran to nearby [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|civilian]] speeders, and Sykes escorted them uphill to the next set of cell blocks, destroying turrets and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] along the way. The rescued prisoners hid behind a [[security hangar]] while Sykes switched to a [[V-19 landspeeder|Gian speeder]] inside. He came out into a maelstrom of fire from the defense turrets. Hollis strafed the camp, blowing a hole into a wall so Sykes could destroy next generator and take the [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fencing off-line. Sykes was able to free the prisoners in that block, and then went up another cliff to take down the generators powering the entrance to the next section of camp.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

===Endgame===
{{Quote|I couldn't let you guys have all the fun!|Lutin Hollis, as he attacks the camp|<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
As Sykes escorted the prisoners downhill into the last group of cell blocks, they were ambushed and trapped by more [[Tank/Legends|tanks]] and fighters. Hollis flew in and took out several tanks and also blew a hole in the wall. The breach allowed Sykes to take down the last generator. Sykes freed the last prisoners and went up a separate hill to destroy the generator, which powered the rear gate. After Hollis' strafing run, Sykes told him to get clear and that they would handle it from there.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

On the way down from the generator, Sykes found advanced laser technology, which was useful to the [[Naboo Resistance]].<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}
Once the gates were down, the rescued prisoners were able to leave. Sykes led them out while firing at the last droids.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Everyone to the speeders. Hurry!|One of the prisoners|<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />}}
With the camp liberated, the Resistance gained new recruits,<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" /> including several seasoned [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|202|Sykes, Lieutenant Gavyn}}</ref> With an expanded force,<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" /> the Resistance set its sights next on [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|retaking]] the [[Theed/Legends|capital]] after Naboo's [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] returned home and forged an [[Battle of the Sacred Place|alliance]] with the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace novelization" />

==Behind the scenes==
The rescue of the Camp Four prisoners was a mission appearing in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. The mission took place in two parts: in a starfighter searching for the camp and in a speeder rescuing the prisoners. The mission would not proceed until the starfighters near the hangar were destroyed. In the course of the mission, it was possible to find an upgrade. Picking it up fulfills the bonus objective. Switching speeders mid-mission was an option, and it was possible to play using the Heavy STAP. Shooting down the landing craft was also optional; its flight path can be traced to the camp, and if left alone, the ship will fly into the camp. Additionally, the player is not required to release the prisoners, only destroying the power generators in the camp, although failing to do so affects the "friendlies rescued" score. This article assumes 100 percent game completion.<ref name="Star Wars:Battle for Naboo" />

The event was also mentioned in the Gavyn Sykes' entry in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="CSWE" /> and was later discussed in the [[2011]] magazine [[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 62|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 62]].<ref name="SVC 62" />
